jobs.title: Research Analytics Data Coordinator
jobs.description:
Transform complex research data into meaningful insights and solutions
Choose to work from our Gold Coast, Coffs Harbour or Lismore campus
Join a collaborative team with scope to explore AI and automation

Be Bold. Belong. Be More.

At Southern Cross University, we do things differently, and so can you.

A career with us is more than you might expect. Yes, it’s about the heart, connectedness and community you’d hope for in a regional university. But there’s also so much more. Our game changing brings a deeper, focused learning experience and our research is deeply connected to our regions, making a difference on a global scale. This is your chance to help us build something new and meaningful for our students, our communities and your career. To drive change, make a real impact, and thrive in a place as unique as you.

You can be good anywhere. Here, you can be great.

Your opportunity

As our Research Analytics Data Coordinator within the Office of the Deputy Vice Chancellor Research, you’ll turn complex research data into reliable insights that support research performance, reporting and decision-making across the University. Working across the research data lifecycle, you’ll combine strong data analytics, SQL, business intelligence and database skills with an understanding of stakeholder needs to develop data pipelines, dashboards and reporting solutions, while helping optimise the University's Research Management System.

You will make an impact by:

Develop and maintain automated data pipelines, datasets and analytics solutions using SQL, BI tools and other appropriate data analysis tools
Manage and enhance the University's Research Management System, collaborating with Technology Services to improve system capability, data quality and business processes
Transform complex research data from multiple systems into accurate dashboards, reports and insights that support research management and strategic decision-making
Support research rankings, performance reporting and external submissions through accurate data extraction, validation, reconciliation and analysis

What You Will Bring

You’re a technically minded data professional who enjoys working with complex datasets, solving problems and finding better ways to turn data into useful information. You’ll bring an analytical mindset, strong database and data pipeline capability, and the ability to work confidently with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

To succeed in this role, you will also need:

A degree-level qualification in information technology, business, research administration, data analytics or a related discipline, with relevant experience in a similar role
Demonstrated experience using SQL and modern Business Intelligence tools, such as Tableau, to extract, transform, analyse and visualise data
Experience developing dashboards, reports and data solutions, with a sound understanding of relational data, data quality and validation
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to diagnose system issues, identify data anomalies and develop practical solutions
The ability to communicate complex data findings clearly to non-technical stakeholders and work collaboratively across a complex organisation

It’s not essential, but we’d love it if you had experience with Python, research administration or research management systems, or working with research data in a higher education, health, government or large not-for-profit environment. Experience with AI and automation tools would also be advantageous.

Why Southern Cross University

SCU is proudly a regional university, young, small and vibrant. That means you’ll find more exposure, opportunity and ownership - to grow, achieve and build a career that means more. And you’ll do it alongside passionate people and leaders who go the extra mile to help you succeed. A career with us is about more than just work. It’s about place, community and the life you want to live. With three main campuses at the , and the region of NSW, we’re integral to all these wonderful communities. Find your place and be more in this beautiful part of the world.

Your opportunity is:

Full-time, continuing (permanent)
Located at either Coffs Harbour, NSW 2450, Gold Coast, QLD 4225, or Lismore, NSW 2480. Relocation assistance is available, making it easier to join our regional communities.
HEW Level 7. The base salary ranges from $108,361 - $117,660 per annum, plus 17% employer’s contribution to superannuation. The total remuneration package is up to $137,662.

You will enjoy a range of perks designed to support your wellbeing, growth and work-life balance. For more information on our benefits and what it’s like to work at SCU, visit

Be more with Southern Cross University today

Southern Cross University values potential as much as experience. If you do not meet all the listed requirements but are excited about the role and confident you can contribute, we encourage you to apply or reach out for more information.

jobs.title: Associate/Senior Associate Environmental and/or Planning Professional
jobs.description:
At Jacobs, we're challenging today to reinvent tomorrow by solving the world's most critical problems for thriving cities, resilient environments, mission-critical outcomes, operational advancement, scientific discovery and cutting-edge manufacturing, turning abstract ideas into realities that transform the world for good.

Your impact

An exciting opportunity is available for an Associate/Senior Associate Environmental and/or Planning Professional
to join our growing Brisbane
based Environmental Planning and Approvals Team
.

Working within a highly regarded team of planners and environmental specialists, you will play a leading role in the delivery of environmental impact assessments and approvals for projects across a strong and diverse pipeline of work. Although the role is Brisbane based, our projects span across Australia across all tiers of government and the private sector, with a focus on transport, renewable energy, power, water and Defence.

This role is ideal for a consultant looking to take the next step in their career, with the opportunity to lead projects, build trusted client relationships and develop technically within a supportive and collaborative team environment.

We offer genuine flexibility, including hybrid working arrangements and full-time or part-time options, helping you balance professional growth with personal commitments.

The role

Working alongside highly experienced planning and environmental professionals, you will contribute to and lead a broad range of environmental and planning approvals as well as impact assessments for projects.

Key Responsibilities Include

Partnering with clients from project inception to develop environmental approvals strategies and define environmental assessment requirements.
Managing planning and environmental studies, specialist investigations and survey programs.
Leading environmental impact assessments across a range of sectors and project scales.
Preparing high-quality environmental approval and planning applications, referral documentation and environmental management plans.
Managing project delivery, budgets, schedules and client expectations.
Leading and contributing to bids and proposal preparation.
Building and maintaining strong relationships with internal and external clients, regulators and multidisciplinary project teams.
Mentoring and supporting early-career professionals.

Here's what you'll need

We are looking for a motivated and capable environmental and/or planning professional who enjoys working on complex projects, building strong client relationships and delivering practical environmental outcomes.

You will bring

A degree or postgraduate qualification in Environmental Science, Environmental Planning, or a related discipline.
Approximately 8-15 years of experience in environmental impact assessment and environmental approvals within Queensland.
Statutory planning experience or knowledge would be highly regarded.
Strong knowledge of Queensland and Commonwealth environmental legislation and approvals processes, as well as an understanding of planning legislation and the interactions between environmental and planning legislation
Demonstrated experience delivering environmental approvals projects and managing competing priorities.
Excellent communication skills with team members, clients and stakeholders and in report-writing.
Strong organisational and project management capabilities.
The ability to work independently while contributing positively to a collaborative team culture.
A commitment to mentoring and supporting the development of junior team members.
Experience with defence projects would be desirable.

Why Join Us?

This role will allow you to

Work on a diverse portfolio of high-profile projects across key industries.
Be part of a growing and supportive team with strong technical leadership.
Access structured career development, mentoring and progression opportunities.
Enjoy genuine workplace flexibility, including hybrid working arrangements.
Take ownership of your work and make a meaningful contribution to projects that shape Australia’s future.

With safety and flexibility always top of mind, we’ve gone beyond traditional ways of working so you have the support, means and space to maximize your potential. You’ll uncover flexible working arrangements, benefits and opportunities, from well-being benefits to our global giving and volunteering program, to exploring new and inventive ways to help our clients make the world a better place. No matter what drives you, you’ll discover how you can cultivate, nurture and achieve your goals – all at a single global company. Find out more about life at Jacobs here.

We aim to embed inclusion and belonging in everything we do. We know that if we are inclusive, we’re more connected and creative. We accept people for who they are, and we champion the richness of diverse perspectives, lived experiences and backgrounds in the workplace, as a source of learning and innovation. We are committed to building vibrant communities within Jacobs, including through our Jacobs Employee Networks, Communities of Practice and our Find Your Community initiatives, allowing every employee to find connection, purpose, and belonging. Find out more about our Jacobs Employee Networks here.

Our meticulously curated employee benefits support ALL employees throughout every stage of life. From paid parental leave to a lifetime financial allowance for you and your partner to access family forming Fertility & IVF treatment, adoption and surrogacy assistance along with menopause and Low T treatment.

We are steadfast in our commitment to the wellbeing of you and your loved ones with a comprehensive suite of wellbeing resources supporting you physically, emotionally and financially. This is demonstrated in our company being recognised by WGEA for 12 consecutive years as an employer of choice for gender equality along with our industry leading GOLD employer status by the Australian Workplace Equality Index.

Cultural Support

Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples are strongly encouraged to apply. Jacobs aims to provide cultural safety at our interviews. Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander people are invited to nominate a cultural representative to participate on the interview panel; please let your recruiter know in your application. No matter what drives you, you'll discover a way to cultivate, nurture and achieve your goals – all at a single global company.

We value collaboration and believe that in-person interactions are crucial for both our culture and client delivery. We empower employees with our hybrid working policy, allowing them to split their work week between Jacobs offices/projects and remote locations enabling them to deliver their best work.

Your application experience is important to us, and we’re keen to adapt to make every interaction even better. If you require further support or reasonable adjustments with regards to the recruitment process (for example, you require the application form in a different format), please contact the team via Careers Support.

jobs.description:
A leading construction organization is seeking an Environmental Specialist to strengthen environmental compliance, governance, and performance across a diverse portfolio of projects. This is an opportunity for an experienced environmental professional to provide practical technical guidance and support project teams in meeting regulatory requirements.

The successful candidate will collaborate with project leadership, site personnel, clients, consultants, and external stakeholders to strengthen environmental processes, promote effective documentation and recordkeeping, and embed sound environmental practices throughout project delivery.

The Role

As Environmental Specialist, you will provide environmental support across a range of projects and operational functions. You will serve as a trusted technical advisor, helping teams interpret environmental requirements and translate them into practical procedures, tools, and controls that can be consistently applied in the field.

This role combines environmental compliance expertise with management-system development, training, audit support, and continuous improvement. You will work with project and corporate teams to identify environmental risks, improve performance, and ensure that programs remain practical, effective, and aligned with applicable requirements.

Key Responsibilities

Provide technical environmental guidance to project teams on compliance requirements, environmental controls, documentation, and recordkeeping.
Develop and maintain environmental programs, management plans, procedures, compliance tools, templates, and guidance materials.
Support the implementation and ongoing improvement of environmental management systems across projects and operations.
Conduct or support environmental audits, inspections, and program reviews to evaluate compliance, identify gaps, and recommend corrective actions.
Identify environmental risks and improvement opportunities, developing practical solutions that support compliance and operational effectiveness.
Develop and deliver training, awareness sessions, and educational materials for project personnel and internal stakeholders.

Qualifications

Post-secondary education in Environmental Science or a related discipline.
At least 5 years of progressive experience in the environmental field.
Working knowledge of environmental legislation, permitting processes, and environmental controls.
Strong technical writing and documentation-review skills.
Confident presentation and training skills, with the ability to communicate environmental expectations effectively to both field-based and office-based audiences.

jobs.title: Environmental Project Manager
jobs.description:
In a world of possibilities, pursue one with endless opportunities. Imagine Next!

At Parsons, you can imagine a career where you thrive, work with exceptional people, and be yourself. Guided by our leadership vision of valuing people, embracing agility, and fostering growth, we cultivate an innovative culture that empowers you to achieve your full potential. Unleash your talent and redefine what’s possible.

Job Description

Parsons is looking for an amazingly talented Environmental Project Manager
to join our team!

The successful candidate will manage site investigation and remediation projects of varying size and complexity, which would include supervision of junior professional environmental staff and technical staff involved in the field investigations, budget control, client liaison and report preparation and review. In addition, the professional would also mentor and provide technical support to more junior staff, as required.

For over 60 years, Parsons has been committed to environmental sustainability, conservation, and restoration. We have developed and tested all types of remediation methods, honing our ability to provide the most effective methods to clean up contaminated soil, water and air! If you are passionate about your environment, and want to work with a team of experts to produce a cleaner and safer world, this is the position for you!

What You'll Be Doing

Provide Project Management and other technical services for multiple projects & clients within our Environmental portfolio
Act as the Company representative with the client and selected subcontractors during the program execution.
Oversee establishment of Project Execution Plan, Health and Safety Plan, Quality Assurance/Quality Control Plan, and other documents as required
Establish the program requirements for all areas of the project, and monitors the draft and final deliverables for adherence to these criteria.
Plans, directs, supervises, and controls the execution of all business, technical, fiscal, and administrative functions of the assigned project.
Works with other managers, project engineers, and discipline leads to develop budgets, schedules, and plans for the various elements of a project. Ensures that the project meets or exceeds goals established in these plans.
Provides key business development support to ongoing pursuits, including development of win strategy preparation of proposal packages
Technical support to Project teams including community/public outreach and regulatory/permitting/compliance,
Provide technical support and leadership/mentorship to junior staff.

What Required Skills You'll Bring

.
